title: Necropolis Dossier
description: One historical Prometheus agent examined as an experimental organism. A Necromancer fills identity..disposition (and optionally descendant_candidate); a Cleric may later implement the descendant. This schema is a compatible SUPERSET of engine/ledger/AGENT_AUTOPSIES.jsonl (the autopsy layer) joined to a descendant-experiment layer. See CHARTER.md for the laws it enforces.

agent_id.description: MUST resolve to a ROSTER.jsonl agent_id.

source_paths.description: Repo paths inspected as evidence (code, state, artifacts).

evidence_baseline.description: Git SHA at which the evidence was read.

premise.description: The hypothesis the agent embodied: if we do X, Y follows.

mechanism.description: How it was meant to work.

consumption_evidence.description: Paths/queries proving downstream consumption (or its absence). See CONSUMPTION.jsonl seam in SEAMS.md.

prior_verdicts.description: Raw citations of earlier dispositions/autopsies (LAW N11). Each is reviewed in death_certificates; none is trusted here.

source.description: Where the historical verdict lives (AGENT_AUTOPSIES.jsonl row, pivot dossier section, disposition plan row).

claim.description: The verdict as written, quoted or tightly paraphrased.

review.description: The Necromancer's review of the certificate. NOT_REVIEWED is honest for a transcription.

errors.description: What the certificate got wrong. Required non-empty for PARTIALLY_UPHELD / OVERTURNED.

death_certificates.description: LAW N17: NECROPOLIS DOES NOT INHERIT DEATH CERTIFICATES. Every historical verdict is a claim under review; this is the review. prior_verdicts holds the raw citations.

verdict.description: Was THIS layer actually valid? VALID needs executed evidence; NOT_EXAMINED is honest; INVALID names at least one cause class.

evidence.description: Paths under dossiers/<agent>_evidence/ or the repo. Required non-empty for VALID and INVALID.

cause_classes.description: Cause classes this layer supports. Empty for NOT_EXAMINED. Empty for VALID except on HYPOTHESIS, where VALID + HYPOTHESIS_FAILURE/PREMISE_FAILURE means a fair test falsified it.

load_bearing.description: For INVALID: did the defect change the historical answer (true), or was it measured not to (false, with evidence)? A layer may be invalid and non-load-bearing; say which.

HYPOTHESIS.description: Was the proposition well-posed and reachable by an experiment at all? VALID here does not mean true; the outcome lives in cause_classes.

cause_of_death_stack.description: Mandatory cause-of-death stack (LAW N17). Every layer is asked: was this layer actually valid? Filled before disposition; the validator refuses HYPOTHESIS_FAILURE / PREMISE_FAILURE unless the layers DESIGN..MEASUREMENT are VALID or INVALID-but-measured-non-load-bearing, and none is NOT_EXAMINED.

verdict.description: The first question of every autopsy: what evidence establishes that this experiment ever received a fair test? FAIR requires DESIGN..MEASUREMENT all VALID or INVALID-but-measured-non-load-bearing, none NOT_EXAMINED.

scope.description: The window / configuration the verdict applies to, when the organism had eras (e.g. post-2026-03-27 honest-battery window only).

primary_cause.description: The proximate cause the evidence best supports. Must appear in some layer's cause_classes. UNDETERMINED only with NOT_EXAMINED layers or classification NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE. PREMISE_FAILURE is the strong claim and is admitted only after every other class has been excluded (premise_exclusion non-empty).

contributing_causes.description: Every other cause class the stack supports, in order of weight. Frankenstein reads these as repair targets (F7).

premise_exclusion.description: Required for PREMISE_FAILURE: the alternative assemblies / repairs / fair tests that were tried and also failed, with evidence paths. Without this the strongest admissible claim is HYPOTHESIS_FAILURE (this experiment falsified this proposition), not PREMISE_FAILURE (the idea itself appears dead).

failure_classes.description: Mechanistic failure typing. SHOULD reference an AUTOPSY_TAXONOMY.md cluster when applicable (DEAD-GATING, LOW-BITS-EMISSION, BOUNDED-MENU-SATURATION, SELECTION-DECOUPLED-FROM-SIGNAL, SEAM-BROKEN, SEMANTIC-TASK-SYNTACTIC-TOOL) or NO-DESIGN-FAILURE-ESTABLISHED. The generic label FAILED is forbidden here and in disposition.classification.

kill_boundary.description: LAW N4: the STRONGEST proposition the evidence legitimately killed, and no stronger. State what is excluded, not merely that it died.

surviving_claims.description: LAW N5: mechanisms/premises STILL compatible with the evidence. May be empty only for a defended TRUE_CORPSE.

frontier_dependent.description: Did the kill boundary depend materially on a moving technological frontier?

frontiers.description: Named frontiers: model capability, context length, tool use, coding ability, inference cost, verifier integration, model reliability, ...

era_bound_claim.description: The claim as it SHOULD be stated: 'era-E model + mechanism + representation + budget could not do X'.

what_would_move_it.description: What changed capability would re-open the boundary, if any.

capability_contingency.description: LAW N16: record whether 'too early' is part of the kill, so it can be tested rather than assumed.

residue.description: LAW N7: typed salvage, not prose.

classification.description: The archaeological state. There is deliberately NO generic FAILED value; the validator hard-rejects it. TRUE_CORPSE requires primary_cause HYPOTHESIS_FAILURE or PREMISE_FAILURE and fair_test FAIR. CAPABILITY_BOUND: killed at power under an era capability the kill boundary names (primary_cause CAPABILITY_CEILING); Frankenstein's lane. NO_FAIR_TEST_ON_RECORD: the evidence establishes the historical experiment could not have answered its own question (fair_test UNFAIR); the hypothesis stands untested, and that is a finding, not a gap.

descendant_candidate.description: OPTIONAL. Present only when a descendant is PROPOSED. If present the validator enforces LAW N6 (consumer + consumption_proof), N8 (changed_design), N9 (expected_if_alive/dead + kill_condition). A dossier with no proposed descendant sets this to null.

changed_design.description: LAW N8: exactly what differs from the historical organism.

consumer.description: LAW N6: a concrete named downstream consumer.

consumption_proof.description: LAW N6: the mechanism that will PROVE consumption (e.g. a CONSUMPTION.jsonl row with a measured effect).

kill_condition.description: LAW N9: the pre-declared condition that ends the resurrection experiment as a failure.
